author: Zintenka
body:
As the war continues, a group of depressed scientists gather together to come up with a way to end the war.

One of them has a purposal, the project is called: 'Scorched Earth'. A thermobaric-nuclear-anti-gravity bomb will launch from orbit. The bomb will enter the atmosphere with a sentient AI controlling it.The AI will threaten to blow up the planet if the two species do not form a peace treaty. 

The two factions immediately surrender and lay down their arms. 

However, the suicidal scientist who created this didnt expect the two factions to surrender at all. In his anger and depression, he deactivates the AI and launches the bomb. The bomb will enter the atmosphere in exactly 40 minutes. 

The factions at first pray to their respective deities for forgiveness and mercy. 

But when offered none, the factions go into a cold-vacant mood. They feel that before the bomb drops, they will take down every hostile bastard on this dying planet... as it was their reason for war in the first place...

Armies who no longer fight for a purpose and with nothing to lose anymore...

The atmosphere is lit up in a purple light as the bomb gets closer and closer... 

War... War Never Changes... II...


Features:
  • 30vs30
  • TNT Warfare
  • Physical Warfare
  • Villager Trades
  • 200 points to win in 40 minutes
